headline: Trump order tells contractors to clear Congress replies
pages: President Trump signed an executive order late Friday directing federal contractors and subcontractors to consult his administration about congressional inquiries and to withhold communications the White House considers privileged. Companies that fail to comply could lose contracts and be suspended from future federal work. The order is the latest move to resist oversight expected from Democrats when they take over Congress in January. Democrats have made government contracts a top target, noting money flowing to firms linked to Trump's family, particularly at the Pentagon.

Separately, White House counsel Will Scharf told agencies they must get approval before agreeing to appear before Congress. Rep. Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on House Oversight, called the order an attack on Congress' oversight right and said Democrats are just getting started. Source: NPR.
